audit.method: independent stage-2 audit, 2026-10-03: re-fetched every cited source live (curl). The generated bodies were measured with ext-parts scripts/audit/step_measure.py. Every sourced fact the part states was checked; these small parts state fewer than 12 sourced facts each, so the count includes the gap, assumption and CAD checks.
